title: Paywall scam
body: App baits you into thinking it’s free. It waits until you’ve used it for x consecutive days then it takes away your access unless you spend money. What a scam.
author: Truth05890

title: Perfect minimal habit tracker
body: I don’t even remember how I came across this app but I’m so happy I found it. I feel like I’ve tried pretty much every habit tracking app but they were always overly complicated or expensive. I love the simplicity of this one and the option to have the vibration of checking off habits give me the little dopamine hit I need. I was also looking for something inexpensive / free and this is a one time payment of $2.99 with a free week to try it.
author: emotionalspinach

title: Best 3.99 I’ve ever spent
body: I promise I’m not paid to say this lol. I used the free trial, and I immediately fell in love with this app. I hate other apps that are unnecessarily complicated with extra useless features and extra cost. I hate apps that require a subscription. I love apps that are simple, 1 time purchase, easy to use, and very helpful. This app is very very helpful, it can change your entire life and discipline, for a really good low cost. I’ve recommended it to someone already, it’s changed my discipline and helped me so much.
author: RandomGuy10010

title: Simple and Limitless
body: Love the simple UI and the number of habits you can track without paying additional fees!
author: Ashcantrellyy

title: Handy app, but should be a non-cloud export/back-up
body: This is a handy little app! Its easy to use and convenient. My only complaint is that the description mentions security being important and that data is stored ONLY on the device and not sent anywhere else. Yet the backup/restore option uses the privacy-invading 'cloud' (euphemism for someone else's computer). Please add a NON-cloud backup or export option. Thanks.
author: Mac100

title: So far pretty good
body: I really like this app because it’s easy to use - a quick way to record activities. I originally downloaded the app to my tablet, then my iPhone. I upgraded to premium on my tablet but the information is not transferring to my phone. I have looked for a way to contact customer support and cannot come up with any information to assist me🤷🏻‍♀️.

author: ryabi

title: Love the simplicity!
body: This is a great little app for keeping track of the things I need to do daily, weekly, bi-weekly and occasionally. It’s simple to use and the clean interface offers no distractions. I love have color around me in my house, but in my phone a simply black and white app (I’m using the dark mode) is so calming. Just what I need to focus on what needs doing. I only downloaded it today and am already loving it! I made 5 tabs with tasks divided between them—then rearranged the tabs to get them in a better order. I’m 69 years old and had no trouble doing any of these set-up tasks. Nice job developers! ❤️
author: Mumsie 3
